title: Eric's launch-day TikTok — '$1.50 Costco Hot Dog & Soda. How is that still the price?'
summary: Eric posted the Costco hot dog story to TikTok on the day Incorruptible went on sale. Costco is one of the book's case studies.
blockquote:
